title: Benchmark code for a data-driven evaluation of optimization techniques in cell culture media
description: Code accompanying the Bioinformatics paper A data-driven evaluation of optimization techniques in cell culture media. Implements two benchmark protocols (Hide-the-Label and Open Race) under two difficulty regimes (Regular and Hard) across six published cell-culture / cell-media datasets, with surrogate families spanning Gaussian processes, random forests, neural networks, and Bayesian neural networks. Bundled with the six input datasets. Post-processed results are not bundled; they are regenerated by the scripts in reproduce/.
